# Diversity Australia

> Diversity Australia delivers DEI workplace training, compliance programs, and consulting services to help organizations build inclusive cultures and meet legal obligations.

Diversity Australia offers comprehensive diversity, equity, and inclusion solutions for Australian and New Zealand workplaces, including compliance training (Respect@Work, WHS, PCBU), capability development (unconscious bias, neurodiversity, psychological safety), leadership coaching, and organizational consulting. The company uses the Diversity Australia Maturity Scale framework to guide progressive workplace transformation.

## Key Topics

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)
- Compliance & Risk Management
- Workplace Health & Safety (WHS)
- Psychological Safety
- Unconscious Bias
- Leadership Development
- Positive Duty
- PCBU (Person Conducting a Business or Undertaking)
- Respect@Work
- Organizational Culture
- Inclusive Workplace
- Neurodiversity
- Anti-Discrimination
- Active Bystander Behaviour
- ISO 45001 & ISO 30415

## Core Solutions

- [Workplace Training Solutions](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solution): Overview of Diversity Australia's progressive training solutions using the Maturity Scale framework.
- [Compliance & Risk Management](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solutions/compliance-risk): Compliance and risk management training covering PCBU, Positive Duty and WHS requirements.
- [Workplace Culture & Capability Training](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solutions/workplace-culture-capability-training): Culture and capability training on unconscious bias, neurodiversity and inclusive leadership.
- [Leadership Development & Coaching](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solutions/leadership-development-coaching): Inclusive leadership coaching programs developing confident leaders and organizational performance.
- [Diversity & Inclusion Consulting Solutions](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solutions/diversity-inclusion-consulting-solutions): DEI consulting services including strategy, risk assessment and organizational culture development.
- [Impactful Keynotes & Inclusive Events](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/solutions/impactful-keynotes-inclusive-events): Keynote speakers and facilitated events on diversity, compliance awareness and psychological safety.

## Compliance & Legal Training Programs

- [Respect at Work Program](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/respect-at-work-program): Respect at Work compliance training on bullying, harassment and respectful workplace behavior.
- [Sexual Harassment in the Workplace for Executives and Boards](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/sexual-harassment-in-the-workplace-for-executives-and-boards): Executive and board training on sexual harassment, Positive Duty and AHRC Seven Standards.
- [PCBU: Person Conducting a Business or Undertaking (WHS) Training](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/pcbu-person-conducting-a-business-or-undertaking-whs-training): PCBU WHS training on officer duties and compliance under Work Health and Safety Act 2011.
- [Equal Employment Opportunity and Anti-Discrimination in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/equal-employment-opportunity-and-anti-discrimination-in-the-workplace): EEO and anti-discrimination training for inclusive workplaces across Australia and New Zealand.

## Workplace Health & Safety Programs

- [Psychosocial Hazards in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/psychosocial-hazards-in-the-workplace): WHS training on psychosocial hazards, mental health and psychological safety in workplaces.
- [Psychological Safety in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/psychological-safety-in-the-workplace): Psychological safety training for teams and leaders aligned with WHS compliance requirements.
- [ISO 45001: Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/iso-45001-occupational-health-and-safety-management-systems): ISO 45001 certification training on occupational health and safety management systems.

## Diversity & Inclusion Capability Programs

- [An Introduction to DE&I in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/an-introduction-to-dei-in-the-workplace): Foundational DE&I training covering bias recognition and inclusive workplace behaviors.
- [Unconscious Bias in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/unconscious-bias-in-the-workplace): Unconscious bias training developing inclusive communication and diversity awareness.
- [Active Bystander Behaviour in the Workplace](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/active-bystander-behaviour-in-the-workplace): Active bystander training developing intervention skills to prevent harassment and bullying.
- [Anti-Racism in the Workplace Program](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/anti-racism-in-the-workplace-program): Anti-racism training promoting cultural safety and inclusive workplace for First Nations peoples.

## Certification & Standards Programs

- [ISO 30415: Human Resource Management – Diversity & Inclusion](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/program/iso-30415-human-resource-management-diversity-inclusion): ISO 30415 certification training on HR diversity and inclusion governance standards.

## Program Index

- [All Programs](https://diversityaustralia.com.au/programs): Index of Diversity Australia's DEI training programs covering compliance, capability and leadership.
